land.lead: Discover trusted services, book with confidence, and manage appointments without the usual back-and-forth. Rebookly connects clients and businesses with smarter booking, fair payment handling, and no-show protection.
land.pricing.title: Simple pricing. You only pay when you earn.
land.pricing.free.name: Free
land.pricing.free.fee: {percent}% of what clients actually pay you for a visit
land.pricing.free.point1: PayPal takes the fee automatically from your payout when a client pays.
land.pricing.free.point2: The client pays exactly the price they saw.
land.pricing.free.point3: No fee on cancellations, late-cancellation fees, no-show fees or released deposits.
land.pricing.free.point5: Payments go straight to your own PayPal account. Rebookly never holds the money.
land.pricing.pro.name: Pro
land.pricing.pro.point4: Pro keeps running until the end of the month already paid, then you move to Free automatically.
land.pricing.note.clients: Clients book for free. Deposits are held, not taken, and count toward their bill.
land.pricing.note.deposit: The deposit you ask clients to keep aside is your choice; we suggest 10% of the price.
land.pricing.faq1.question: When is the 3% taken?
land.pricing.faq1.answer: Only when a client pays you for a visit, automatically by PayPal.
land.pricing.faq2.question: Do I pay anything if a client cancels or doesn't come?
land.pricing.faq2.answer: No. Nothing on cancellations, no-shows or released deposits.
land.pricing.faq3.question: Can I switch plans?
land.pricing.faq3.answer: Yes, any time from Settings → Plan and fees.
land.pricing.faq4.question: Who pays the 3%?
land.pricing.faq4.answer: You do, from the payment you receive. The client pays the price they saw.
